verdict.rationale: Sill's own privacy page says it has no account and no server, and that your screen and typing travel only between your own devices. It also states there are no analytics, tracking or third-party SDKs, so the vendor never receives user data that could be used for training. However, protection from AI training is only implied by this architecture: there is no explicit no-AI-training statement or policy. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that user data is never used to train AI models, and independent or hands-on verification (e.g. a network audit) that no data leaves the user's devices.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
No analytics, ads or tracking, and no code from third parties (SDKs) in either app.
